decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter built directly on the firm's core lighting-system know-how, it fits existing capabilities well and is therefore likely to be retained and improved rather than withdrawn.
This LED luminaire line is close to the firm's established lighting business, so the firm can learn from market feedback and refine it within its strong existing knowledge base.

The home automation server box is still related to the firm's offer but is somewhat less central than luminaires, making it the most at risk if results disappoint, though related control-system knowledge still supports continuation.
A luminaire family sits squarely within the firm's main competences in premium interior lighting, so absorptive capacity and favorable industry conditions point to keeping it on the market.
